kept.intent: An executive operating system is a written arrangement of priorities, decision rules and recurring reviews for managing work. It connects what matters to the next action and records what happened afterward. Spry uses the term for a personal planning method, which can be run on paper or with an AI assistant.

A reset cycle is a pattern of making an ambitious plan, missing part of it and abandoning the routine until a fresh start feels possible. A restart rule interrupts that pattern by defining the smallest useful action after a miss, so returning does not require clearing an accumulated backlog or redesigning the plan.

A phone vortex is an informal description of a quick phone check expanding into an unplanned sequence of scrolling, notifications and app switching. The practical issue is the gap between why you picked up the phone and what happened next. A boundary makes the intended use explicit and gives you a stopping point.

A personal scorecard is a short record of actions and results used to decide what to change in a routine. It works best when each measure has a clear definition, a reliable place to record it and a review question. The purpose is to inform a decision, rather than assign a score to your worth.

Deep work is sustained attention on a demanding task with a defined outcome and limited avoidable interruption. A practical focus block specifies what you will produce, what materials you need and how you will resume after a disruption. It is a working arrangement to adapt to your responsibilities, rather than a universal schedule.

AI coaching at scale is the use of software-supported reflection and planning routines across a team or organization. A responsible rollout defines the purpose, permitted data, human oversight and reporting boundaries before inviting participants. Capabilities vary by product and contract, so privacy or effectiveness must be verified rather than assumed from a coaching label.

Executive coaching prompts are instructions for a structured reflection with an AI assistant about a work goal, decision or leadership situation. They provide relevant context, ask for questions before recommendations and end with an explicit next action. The assistant supports preparation and reflection; it does not become a qualified human coach or make decisions for you.

A structured ChatGPT conversation is a working thread with an explicit purpose, current context, agreed constraints and a clear handoff at the end. It separates exploration from decisions and records which facts still need checking. Structure helps you review the exchange without assuming the assistant remembers every detail or that its summary is accurate.

Personal operating system is a personal agreement about how you capture obligations, choose work and review commitments. List the places where promises currently live, including messages, notebooks and calendars.
Principles, rules and routines is three different planning layers: values explain why, decision rules choose between options, and routines specify when to act.
Daily operator plan is a daily record of the outcome, constraints and next action you intend to manage; the title is a planning metaphor, not a wealth claim.
ChatGPT accountability system is a human-reviewed record of commitments and check-ins that uses an AI assistant to organize what you report.

Working knowledge system is a reference collection organized around decisions and deliverables rather than the quantity of saved material. Choose a current project and identify the reference needed for its next decision.
Daily highlight planning with ChatGPT is a way to ask an assistant to propose one meaningful daily deliverable within your actual commitments; it does not imply an endorsement by any named creator.

Flexible morning structure is a short starting sequence that adapts to the time and responsibilities available that morning. Identify the first unavoidable appointment and the preparation it requires.
Identity-based execution is a planning approach that translates a chosen value into an observable action rather than a label about who you are.
Personal KPI selection is the choice of a small set of measures that change a planning decision rather than merely decorate a dashboard.
Leverage in everyday work is the reuse of an asset or process across useful tasks; it is not a promise of financial gain.
AI coaching options is different ways to obtain planning prompts and reflection, including self-guided notes, AI assistance and human support.
Accountability check-in prompt is a request that compares your stated commitment with evidence you supply and proposes a next action for your review.
Capture, distill and use workflow is a three-stage way to save a source, record why it matters and bring that note into a current task.

Workload review during exhaustion is an organizational review of commitments and capacity, not a diagnosis or treatment for burnout. Identify obligations that need immediate coverage and tasks that can be deferred with communication.
Bounded planning review is a review with a stopping point that produces a chosen action rather than an ever larger plan; twenty minutes is an illustrative time box.
Project finishing review is a check of the remaining acceptance, handoff and approval work needed to call a project complete.
Goal continuity plan is a record that keeps a goal connected to a feasible next action when the original schedule breaks.
Work boundary script is a concise way to state a current commitment, a capacity constraint and an alternative when new work arrives.

Quarterly outcome plan is a planning record that connects a quarter’s intended outcome to milestones, constraints and review decisions. Choose a verifiable end-of-quarter result and list the dependencies that could prevent it.

Disrupted-day morning plan is a starting routine designed around variable obligations rather than a fixed ideal timetable. Identify what must happen before the first fixed obligation and prepare only that sequence.
Knowledge capture checklist is a check of whether a saved item has enough provenance and context to be useful later.

Decision load review is an inventory of recurring choices that can be simplified through defaults or clarified ownership. List repeated low-stakes choices alongside decisions that require fresh judgment.
Discipline and motivation is two different planning ideas: motivation describes wanting to act, while discipline commonly describes following a chosen commitment.

Commitment exit review is a deliberate decision about whether to continue, reduce, hand off or stop a commitment. List the obligation, its remaining value, the cost of continuation and anyone affected by stopping.

End-of-day handoff is a short record that lets you resume work without reconstructing the entire previous session. Record what changed, what is blocked and the file or person needed for the next action.

Daily capacity plan is a schedule that fits chosen work around fixed commitments and explicitly leaves room for uncertainty. Put fixed appointments and necessary preparation on the calendar before choosing optional work.
Weekly commitment plan is a review of deadlines, capacity and dependencies across the next working week. Collect commitments from your calendar and messages and identify missing inputs.
AI-assisted decision brief is a draft that organizes options, assumptions and missing evidence for a person who retains the decision.
Weekly review prompt is an instruction to compare planned work with a supplied record and produce a small set of next-week decisions.
Multi-project status review is a review that exposes deadlines and blocked dependencies across several projects without merging all their tasks into one undifferentiated list.
Decision default design is the creation of a reversible rule for a recurring choice with a known owner and exception condition.

Minimum daily action is the smallest action that preserves a current commitment’s purpose on a constrained day. Identify the obligation that matters today and define a useful action small enough to start.
Work value review is a check of whether an activity changes a deliverable, resolves a risk or supports an actual responsibility.
AI role separation is a workflow in which drafting, checking and approval are treated as different responsibilities even when software assists several steps.

Cross-priority planning is a way to compare competing commitments using a shared record of deadlines, consequences and next actions. List each priority’s next deliverable and the consequence of postponing it.
Planning tool audit is a review of whether maintaining a tool helps you start, complete or review real work. Observe a recent task from capture through completion and note repeated copying or setup.
Weekly reset checklist is a review that clears expired tasks and prepares the next week’s real commitments; Sunday is an optional review day.
AI-supported reflection is the use of an assistant to organize a self-reported work problem and suggest questions for human review.
Goal evidence log is a record connecting an intended outcome to dated evidence, with AI assistance limited to organizing supplied information.

A minimum viable day is a deliberately reduced plan for a day with unusually limited capacity. It identifies necessary obligations, a feasible action and what must be deferred or renegotiated, rather than requiring an ordinary day’s output under different conditions.

boundary: Historical Spry observations on the daily-execution-loop and AI-chief-of-staff URLs retain their already-established BHPC ownership and published pages. No page with measured GSC impressions is retired by this rescue. Indexed status alone is not demand: duplicate topic hubs, synthetic agent variants and unsupported health advice consolidate to the closest practical guide.
